items.title: Ed Garland Interview, 1958-08-08; 1958-09-03
items.q: I used to see, Jimmy and this boy was playing with the Imphil band... And that's a Jimmy Brown.

ctx.x: He died basically. Jimmy Brown. Jimmy Brown, that's his name. And Oak Gasper and the Imperial Band.
Well can you tell us, when you first took up music, did you start on bass or any other instrument? What was your first instrument? Guitar. Oh yeah.
